author: Cleo Abram
description:
The Sun isn’t the center of the solar system…at least, not right now! Stick with me

Everything with gravity pulls on each other, so the SUN pulls on us but we pull on the Sun too! 

And we’re teeny, which barely makes a difference. But JUPITER is massive…. 

But what if Earth actually WAS the center of the solar system? To see that, subscribe!

#science #sun #earth #solarsystem #space #physics
title: The Sun Isn’t The Center of the Solar System
